{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import io
p='HANDOFF.md'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old_status="## Status: specify phase COMPLETE (2026-10-17)"
new_status=("## Status: specify phase COMPLETE for milestone 3 (2026-10-17)\n"
"- Milestone 3 (R07/R08 idempotency token) added to spec.md; R01-R06 + Claim-A extensions retained.\n"
"- spec.md now contains FR-010 (token replay/mismatch/failure/invalid), FR-011 (bookkeeping scope, preview signature, detached returns), US6, token edge cases, Key Entity 'Idempotency token', SC-009/SC-010, token assumptions.\n"
"- checklists/requirements.md updated with milestone-3 block, all [x], 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers.\n\n## Status: specify phase COMPLETE (2026-10-17)")
assert old_status in s
s=s.replace(old_status,new_status,1)
# extend active requirements list
old_req="- Claim-A r2: R05 clarification - successful apply advances next-insertion-ID state and writes it back to the underlying table; subsequent inserts (apply or direct db.insert) continue sequence without reuse/rewind, even across removes."
new_req=(old_req+"\n"
"- M3: R07 apply(operations, token=None): nonempty string token; repeat of successful identical batch/token returns detached copy of original inserted IDs without rerunning mutations (even after direct db writes); token reuse with different ops raises ValueError, no data change; failed batches do not consume token; None = normal; invalid token raises ValueError.\n"
"- M3: R08 token bookkeeping per BatchWriter instance only, never in user documents; preview keeps original signature, never records/consumes tokens; returned lists must not expose bookkeeping through mutation.")
assert old_req in s
s=s.replace(old_req,new_req,1)
# update implementation contract
old_c="New file tinydb/journal.py: class BatchWriter(db) with apply(operations)->list[int], preview(operations)->list[int]; default table only; ValueError on all malformed/missing cases; deepcopy isolation; snapshot+restore rollback; _next_id management per above; clear_cache() on rollback."
new_c=(old_c+"\n"
"- M3 addition: apply(operations, token=None); per-instance dict token -> (canonical ops content, original inserted IDs); validate token type before any mutation; on success store binding; on replay with identical ops return list(stored IDs) copy; on mismatch raise ValueError; failed/invalid batches store nothing; preview never touches token state; all returned lists are fresh copies.")
assert old_c in s
s=s.replace(old_c,new_c,1)
io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print('HANDOFF updated, len',len(s))
PY"}
